shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json next.config.ts app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/layout.tsx; do printf '\\nFILE %s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "for f in app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do printf '\\nFILE %s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git log -1 --oneline && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files .next/server/app | head -40 && rg -n -o 'Dashboard|Total Revenue|Latest Invoices|Loading dashboard data' .next/server/app/index.html .next/server/app/index.rsc 2>/dev/null | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && rg -n \"partialPrefetching\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' -m 1 | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- next.config.ts app/page.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
workspace = Path('/workspace')
build_dir = workspace / '.next'
if build_dir.is_dir() and not build_dir.is_symlink():
    shutil.rmtree(build_dir)
for name in ('next-env.d.ts', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'):
    generated_file = workspace / name
    if generated_file.is_file() and not generated_file.is_symlink():
        generated_file.unlink()
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
